halfLife.notes: Short parent half-life. ER formulation produces flatter levels but does not extend clinical half-life meaningfully. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: O-desmethylvenlafaxine (ODV)
activeMetabolite.notes: ODV is itself active and is marketed separately as desvenlafaxine. Contributes meaningfully to total exposure. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Mild CYP2D6 inhibition; clinically minor. Levels can be markedly raised by potent CYP2D6 inhibitors (e.g. fluoxetine, paroxetine, bupropion) — relevant on overlap. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

discontinuationSyndromeRisk.notes: Among the worst for discontinuation symptoms (electric-shock sensations, dizziness, irritability). Slow taper required, especially from doses >150 mg. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Extended-release capsules dominate the Malaysian market; immediate-release rare. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
